en.docTitle: Earth of Everything | A Plain-Language Guide to Geography
en.docDesc: Geography made plain: countries and regions, climate and biomes, landmarks, and the explorers who measured the world. Bilingual and ad-free.
en.heroSub: From terrain and climate to rivers and ranges, from country profiles to pioneers of exploration — the world in plain language. Neutral, structured, bilingual and free of ads.
en.heroIssue: Found a problem or have a suggestion? Open an issue or send an email:

en.mail.body:
Hi,

I would like to share feedback / a suggestion:
(please describe briefly)

—— Page / module / location:
(e.g. Countries - China)

—— Expected improvement (optional):

Thanks!
en.homeLead: From countries to biomes, from rivers to people — pick a section to begin your journey.
en.refsSub: An educational summary; key claims are sourced. For learning only, not professional advice.
en.entry.schools.d: Representative countries and regions: terrain, climate and hubs
en.entry.questions.d: Rainforest, savanna, desert, taiga — how Earth drapes itself in zones
en.entry.principles.d: Plates, circulation, the water cycle and landform evolution — how Earth works underneath
en.entry.classics.d: Yangtze, Nile, Himalaya, Great Barrier Reef — the ranges that shaped civilization
en.entry.thinkers.d: Zheng He, Humboldt, Magellan, Cousteau — how they measured the world
en.schools.title: Countries & Regions
en.schools.sub: Terrain, climate, location and capitals — build spatial intuition for the world's key countries. Tap a card for details.
en.questions.title: Climate & Biomes
en.questions.sub: Why rainforests here and deserts there? Each zone lists its distribution, traits and why it matters.
en.principles.title: Physical Principles
en.principles.sub: Plate tectonics, climate genesis, three-cell circulation, the water cycle and landform evolution — how Earth shapes its surface. Tap a card for the mechanism and key points.
en.classics.title: Landmarks
en.classics.sub: Rivers, mountains, lakes and reefs — not just beautiful, but shapers of civilization and water security. Tap for the gist and impact.
en.thinkers.title: Explorers & Geographers
en.thinkers.sub: Zheng He, Humboldt, Magellan, Cousteau, Ibn Battuta — how each set out to measure the world.
